# Templates

This directory holds reusable document templates for new projects or future docs inside the same repository.

## Available templates
- `adr-template.md`
- `plan-template.md`
- `session-checkpoint-template.md`
- `approval-item-template.md`
- `status-report-template.md`
- `spec-ears-template.md`
- `spec-gherkin-template.md`
- `learning-template.md`

## Usage rules
- Copy a template only when the destination document does not already exist.
- Adapt the template to the project instead of keeping placeholder text around.
- Keep agent-facing control language in English.
- Keep product-facing planning content in Korean if that remains the project preference.
